candidates.explanation: After verifying the reset hash, the method updates the user's password but never revokes existing sessions. Refresh tokens are tied to session rows (refreshToken calls updateByHash), so a device that was already signed in can keep refreshing its login after the reset. Other flows delete sessions (the password change in `update` calls deleteByUserIdWithExclude), but resetPassword does not call sessionService.deleteByUserId.

fix.description: After updating the password in resetPassword, delete all of the user's sessions. This needs `await this.sessionService.deleteByUserId({ userId: user.id });` right after `await this.usersService.update(user.id, user);`.
